paper_title: Analysis of the Period Recovery Error Bound
classifications: Theory of computation → Sorting and searching
statement: Finally, can the hierarchy be extended to the other side? Come up with tight error bounds that lead to a set of n period candidates, where  < 1.
context: It is of interest to apply the ideas of section 6 to the log(i) hierarchy and eliminate the dependence on . Finally, can the hierarchy be extended to the other side? Come up with tight error bounds that lead to a set of n period candidates, where  < 1.
